words.def: of a high quality or pleasant
words.ex: This is a really good book.

words.def: of low quality or unpleasant
words.ex: The weather was bad all week.

words.def: made or bought recently; not old
words.ex: She bought a new phone.

words.def: having existed for a long time
words.ex: They live in an old house.

words.def: large in size or amount
words.ex: They have a big garden.

words.def: little in size or amount
words.ex: It's a small but cosy flat.

words.def: measuring a lot from one end to the other
words.ex: She has long hair.

words.def: small in length, distance, or height
words.ex: It was a short trip.

words.def: far above the ground or above average
words.ex: The prices here are very high.

words.def: not far above the ground or below average
words.ex: Speak in a low voice, please.

words.def: having a high temperature
words.ex: Be careful, the soup is hot.

words.def: having a low temperature
words.ex: It's cold outside today.

words.def: not difficult to do
words.ex: The test was quite easy.

words.def: difficult to do, or firm and solid
words.ex: This exercise is really hard.

words.def: happening near the beginning of a period
words.ex: I caught an early train.

words.def: happening after the usual or expected time
words.ex: Sorry I'm late for the meeting.

words.def: feeling or showing pleasure
words.ex: She looked happy at the party.

words.def: feeling or showing unhappiness
words.ex: He felt sad after the film.

words.def: very pleasant to look at
words.ex: What a beautiful sunset!

words.def: having a big effect or great value
words.ex: This is an important decision.
